clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Orgrimmar, Ragefire Chasm threatens the Horde from below. Its magma-lit tunnels hold savage troggs, and the Cleft of Shadow gives access to the caverns.

Beneath Orgrimmar, dangers threaten the capital from below. While Thrall works to secure Durotar above, Ragefire troggs infest the chasm’s unstable vents and magma rivers. They rose from unknown depths and violently rejected Magatha Grimtotem’s attempts at diplomacy. Left unchecked, their numbers could undermine the city and overrun it.
